name: dwi2b0
summary: Extracts the b0 volumes from a DWI series with MRtrix3 dwiextract and outputs their voxel-wise mean or, optionally, an ANTs rigid b0 template.
description: Runs MRtrix3 dwiextract -shell 0 to pull out all non-diffusion-weighted volumes with their gradient files, then either averages them with mrmath or, when template is set, builds a rigid-only template with ANTs antsMultivariateTemplateConstruction2.sh. Use it to get a clean b0 reference image for registration or masking. The input DWI needs bvals/bvecs that mark at least one b=0 volume.

inputs.description: 4D diffusion-weighted image with its bvals and bvecs.
inputs.requirements: Must contain at least one b=0 volume.

outputs.description: The mean non–diffusion-weighted (b₀) image was generated by averaging all b₀ volumes.
The 4D volume is constructed by concatenating all of the b₀ images from the diffusion-weighted imaging series.

parameters.description: When this option is enabled, a b₀ template is generated instead of computing a simple voxel‐wise average of the b₀ volumes.

citations.text: Avants BB, Tustison NJ, Song G, Cook PA, Klein A, Gee JC. A reproducible evaluation of ANTs similarity metric performance in brain image registration. NeuroImage 54(3):2033-2044 (2011).
Tournier JD et al. MRtrix3: A fast, flexible and open software framework for medical image processing and visualisation. NeuroImage (2019).
